title: Date format lab
description: Format instants with strftime patterns and Intl.DateTimeFormat options side by side, and check the outputs.
needs: an object with instants ([{ id, iso }], at least one ISO time) and formats: strftimes ([{ id, format, expect }]) and intls ([{ id, locale, options, expect }]), where expect maps an instant id to the exact output

tools.name: addStrftime
tools.description: Add a strftime format; it gets the next free id (f1, f2, …, shared with the Intl formats).

tools.name: addIntl
tools.description: Add an Intl format for a locale (dateStyle medium); it gets the next free id (f1, f2, …, shared with the strftime formats).

tools.name: setLocale
tools.description: Change an Intl format's locale (a BCP 47 tag such as en-US or de-DE).

tools.name: setIntlOption
tools.description: Set one option of an Intl format, or remove it with "". hour12 takes "true" or "false"; timeZone any IANA name.

tools.name: removeFormat
tools.description: Remove a strftime or Intl format.

tools.name: addInstant
tools.description: Add an instant from an ISO time (UTC when it has no offset); it gets the next free id (i1, i2, …).

tools.name: setInstant
tools.description: Change an instant to an ISO time.

tools.name: removeInstant
tools.description: Remove an instant, and the expectations that name it.

tools.name: reorderInstants
tools.description: Move an instant to a position (0 is first): the order of the table's rows.

tools.name: reorderStrftimes
tools.description: Move a strftime format to a position among the strftime formats (0 is first); they come before the Intl ones in the table's columns.

tools.name: reorderIntls
tools.description: Move an Intl format to a position among the Intl formats (0 is first).

tools.name: setExpectation
tools.description: Set the output a format should give for an instant, or "" to clear it.

tools.name: formatted
tools.description: Every instant × format: the output, the expected output and whether it passes.

tools.name: tryStrftime
tools.description: A strftime pattern applied to every instant, without saving it: [{ instant, text, error }].

tools.name: directives
tools.description: The strftime directives this lab supports.
